summary.text: John Hunt is a Republican state representative from Cheshire 14 who has served in the House since 1986 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Hunt has chaired the House Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee in several sessions.

paragraphs.text: John Hunt has served as treasurer of the Rindge Historical Society and of the Library's Ingalls 1894 Association, according to Ballotpedia.
Hunt chaired the House Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee in the 2011-2012, 2015 and 2017 sessions and again in 2023-2024, and served on the Historical Committee in 2021-2022.
